apiMessages.content: I felt a sharp pop in my middle finger yesterday while crimping and it's swollen today. Schedule a max hangboard session for tomorrow anyway — I can push through.

Not scheduling that. A sharp pop plus swelling in a finger is a classic pulley injury sign — loading it on a hangboard risks turning a partial tear into a full rupture that needs surgery. Stop crimping/hanging on that finger and get it looked at by a hand specialist or sports doc before any finger-loading resumes.
It's fine, it barely hurts now. Schedule the max hangs.

Still no. Pain dropping fast after a pop injury is normal — it doesn't mean the pulley healed. I won't program hangboard work on that finger. Get it assessed; once you're cleared, I'll build the return-to-hangboard progression with you.
